title: Refined size, quantity and product reassurance section
summary: Simplify product options into consistent outlined controls and lighter supporting rows.

changes.detail: Use a 52px size selector with plain selected value and checkmark, a matching 46px quantity stepper with 44px button targets, and explicit quantity button roles.
Remove the nested size badge, redundant Selected label, circular chevron background, nested quantity button fills, share pill and bulky reassurance panel.
Use quieter review/share text, consistent corners and a single subtle divider above reassurance details. Existing size selection and quantity limits are retained.
